valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027 pro forma EPS viewed at the 12-month target date, November 2027)

bear.driver: Memory component cost inflation and supply headwinds compress gross margin back toward 58%, while consumer wearable demand moderates.
bear.assumption: FY2027E pro forma EPS $10.50 at 22.0x P/E

base.driver: Outdoor (fenix 9) and Fitness momentum sustains ~6.5% EPS growth off FY2026 guidance ($10.80), partially offset by gross margin normalization from 61.0% toward 58%-59%.
base.assumption: FY2027E pro forma EPS $11.50 at 25.5x P/E

bull.driver: Continued double-digit wearable and marine growth plus operating leverage offset component cost headwinds and support multiple expansion.
bull.assumption: FY2027E pro forma EPS $12.50 at 28.0x P/E

valuation.implied_by_close: At $11.50 base FY2027E EPS, the $283.03 close implies 24.6x; the 5-analyst average target (~$296.40) implies 25.8x or $11.62 EPS at 25.5x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $11.50 (4.1 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Gross margin trajectory (management guided normalization toward 58%-59% in 2027 from 63.3% in Q3 2026 due to memory component costs) and Outdoor/Fitness revenue growth.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 earnings release and FY2027 guidance (expected February 2027).

analyst_notes: Following Garmin's Q3 2026 beat ($2.76 pro forma EPS vs. ~$2.39 consensus) and raised FY2026 EPS guidance ($10.80), four of five tracked analysts updated targets between Oct 29 and Nov 2, 2026: J.P. Morgan ($310), Morgan Stanley ($295), and BofA ($230) raised targets, while Barclays trimmed to $277. Ratings remain clustered at Hold/Neutral (3 Hold, 1 Buy, 1 Sell), with BofA flagging lowered FY2026 FCF guidance ($1.1B) from inventory and memory prepayments. The ~$296.40 equal-weight target is ~1.1 pp above our $293.25 base case, equivalent to ~$0.12 in FY2027E EPS or ~0.3x P/E.
